extraction.Name: Annie Dubray
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded January 28, 1922, by J. R. Martin
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged by Annie and Charles Dubray on March 31, 1922 to Peters Trust Company for $1500; Annie Moran Dubray and Charles Dubray conveyed the land to Renwick Cross for $1.00 and other valuable consideration on May 29, 1922
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739633 issued; Northeast quarter section 32, township 98, range 77; no receipt for the patent is shown
